name: Ultimate Metro
summary: Compact two-platform metro terminus for reversible lightrail on ordinary electric tramtrack.
description: Ultimate Metro 0.8.5 shortens the surface head plaza from 10m to 5m, retaining two trees and four flowering planters in a compact layout. Pedestrian access and the terrain footprint follow the shorter head. Native tram paving is now rendered underneath the native rail texture along the tracks and crossover, matching the two material layers of standard tramtrack. The original ground fill was gravel, not the missing tram paving layer. Vehicle paths, 80m platforms, speeds, external track connection and underground station are unchanged. Place a new surface station to check visual continuity and boarding. Existing saved geometry is not rebuilt automatically. Do not remove the mod while its stations remain.
